launch_slurm_job: submit a FairChem job to a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable nodes and GPUs
launch_local_job: launch a FairChem job locally using torch elastic for multi-worker or single-process execution
run_slurm_spmd_program: execute a SPMD program on SLURM with distributed setup, seeding, and checkpoint support
map_job_config_to_dist_config: convert a FairChem JobConfig into a distributed training config with world size and backend
remove_runner_state_from_submission: decouple a SLURM job submission from runner state to prevent stale checkpoint resubmission
